product.name: Personalized Glossy Gift Wrapping Paper – Custom Gift Wrap Pack (10 Sheets)
product.description:
Enhance your gift presentation with our Premium Gift Packing Paper Pack of 10. These high-quality 12×18 inch gift wrapping sheets are printed on 130 GSM glossy paper, offering a smooth finish and vibrant appearance. Perfect for birthdays, weddings, Diwali celebrations, parties, and special occasions, these wrapping sheets help make every gift look elegant and attractive.

 

Each pack includes 10 durable glossy sheets, ideal for wrapping small to medium-sized gifts with ease. The premium paper quality ensures a stylish and professional look while adding charm to your presents.

 

Whether you are preparing gifts for festivals, celebrations, or special moments, these multi-occasion gift wrapping papers provide the perfect finishing touch.

 

Product Details

 

Pack of 10 Gift Wrapping Sheets

Size: 12 × 18 Inches

Paper Quality: 130 GSM Premium Glossy Paper

Suitable for Birthday, Diwali, Wedding, Party & Festive Gifts
